name: Squadika
description:
About This Game

Trapped in the arena between Heaven and Hell, a squad of unlikely heroes fights for the amusement of Angels and Demons. Survive brutal waves of monsters, build your party from classic fantasy classes, sacrifice fallen allies for power, and recruit new warriors between battles.

An angel merchant offers blessed artifacts in the shop, while seductive demonesses reward victorious champions with cursed treasures torn from defeated bosses. In this endless clash of steel, magic, and sin, only the strongest squad will survive the judgment of the arena.

HOW LONG CAN YOUR SQUAD SURVIVE?

Squadika is a roguelite arena survival game where a band of heroes fights for glory. Battle through relentless waves of demons, monsters, and deadly bosses while building the ultimate squad from powerful fantasy classes. Recruit new heroes, collect powerful relics, sacrifice fallen allies for strength, and create game-breaking combinations to survive as long as possible.

The Arena demands blood. How many waves can your squad endure?

BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE SQUAD

Slay enemies, collect experience, and grow stronger with every wave. Each level-up grants random upgrades, powerful relics, and game-changing abilities that can transform your squad into an unstoppable force. Combine classes, items, and synergies to create devastating builds unique to every run.

The stronger your heroes become, the louder the Arena roars for more blood.

Game Features

  • Auto-attacking combat with optional manual aiming for maximum control

  • Fast-paced runs designed to be completed in under 30 minutes

  • Create unique squad builds and strategies: zerg rush, lone wolf, suicide team, and more

  • Choose between heroes aligned with Good or Bad

  • Recruit and upgrade dozens of fantasy classes including Warriors, Mages, Assassins, Clerics, and more

  • Survive intense waves of monsters and bosses lasting from 20 to 90 seconds

  • Earn gold after every battle to buy powerful items, relics, and new heroes from the angelic merchant

  • Defeat bosses and claim demonic treasures delivered by seductive demonesses

  • Tons of items, synergies, and build combinations for endless replayability

  • Adjustable difficulty options: customize enemy health, damage, and speed to match your playstyle

  • Twitch integration - heroes can receive the names of viewers from chat and speak on their behalf
short_desc: Top-down arena shooter roguelite where fallen Steam friends & Twitch chatters become your power. Control a squad, survive relentless waves and defeat powerful bosses. Compete on leaderboards! Bullet hell Brotato-like with wild builds, random events & high replayability.
